pages.title: Saturation Modifier
pages.text: Depending on how the mod is configured, foods that are unseasoned may receive a saturation penalty. Similarly, seasoned foods will grant extra saturation, depending on how many different kinds of spices were used. When a seasoned food ends up with no effects, it ends up with a "participation award" saturation boost. If the mod AppleSkin is installed, the tooltip will show the adjusted saturation (but not the hunger bar overlay).
